name: Kirkland Signature Trail Mix (Almonds, Cashews, Peanuts, Raisins & M&Ms)
whyItWorks: Packed with whole crunchy almonds, cashews, peanuts, and chewy dehydrated raisins. Whole unchewed nut fragments and leathery dried fruit skins are the leading cause of food-bolus bowel obstructions in Crohn's patients with strictures.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Severe Stricture & Flare Hazard: Strictly avoid if you have IBD, strictures, or an ostomy. Do not consume.
